options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: death_link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: enable_main_quest_locations
options.description: Include locations usually containing items to complete the main quest. When disabled, core items will stay in the item pool and filler items are placed at these locations

options.name: enable_heart_ruby_locations
options.description: Include Heart ruby locations.

options.name: enable_energy_gem_locations
options.description: Include Energy gem locations.

options.name: enable_ancient_vault
options.description:
Include upgrades from Ancient Vault.
Warning: The logical requirement to clear this is bare minimum. Even while having every item in the game I consider these checks extremely difficult. God gamers only.

options.name: enable_moonstone_locations
options.description: Include Moonstone locations.

options.name: enable_lunar_artifacts_locations
options.description: Include Lunar Artifact locations

options.name: enable_fishing_spots
options.description: Include items gotten from catching fish

options.name: enable_npc_gifts
options.description: Include free gifts from NPCs

options.name: enable_planto_rewards
options.description: Include rewards from Mr. Planto after giving them food units

options.name: enable_breakables
options.description: Include utility items found in breakable objects like pots and boxes

options.name: enable_sidequests
options.description: Include checks related to sidequests

options.name: enable_freestanding
options.description: Include utility items found in freestanding locations

options.name: enable_minigames
options.description: Include items won through minigames

options.name: enable_perros
options.description: Include findable Perros

options.name: enable_misc
options.description: Include miscellaneous locations (Strange Urn & Atai berry selling reward)

options.name: shop_sanity
options.description: Includes items that can be bought it shops

options.name: enable_small_animal_drops
options.description: Includes drops from animals like lizards, mice and scorpions

options.name: enable_rin_locations
options.description: Includes rin pickups from chests and other breakables that give at least 5 rin

options.name: enable_trap_chests
options.description: Includes chests that usually contain only 1 Rin

options.name: enable_geo_challenge_rewards
options.description: Includes the rewards you get from completing GEO challenges

options.name: enable_ouroboros_shrines
options.description: Includes the rewards at the end of Ouroboros Shrines

options.name: start_with_wooden_bat
options.description: Start out with wooden bat

options.name: upgradable_bats
options.description: Instead of finding bats of random tiers, upgrade up one tier every time you find a bat

options.name: upgradable_tools
options.description: Upgradable tools are found in order. e.g. civilian crossbow is always found before double crossbow

options.name: upgradable_spear
options.description: Instead of Sonic Spear and Spear Bomb being two separate items, you will always find Sonic Spear first and then upgrade with the Spear Bomb

options.name: upgradable_prelude
options.description: Instead of Prelude of Panselo and the Spell of Rejuvenation being two separate items, you will always find Prelude of Panselo first and then upgrade it with the Spell of Rejuvenation first

options.name: open_panselo_gates
options.description: Opens the Panselo gates by default. The gates require a weapon to be opened. Enabling this setting will increase the amount of starting locations

options.name: keep_excluded_status_upgrades_in_item_pool
options.display_name: Keep status upgrades and moonstones in item pool when locations are excluded
options.description:
When enabled, Heart rubies, Energy gems and Moonstones will stay in the item pool if not included. Filler items are placed at the disabled locations.
When disabled, these items can be acquired at their vanilla locations.
Warning: disabling this setting is incompatible with certain other settings as these items are required in the pool

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
